I am an old woman, and this small plot of beans is what I have. I keep my bean seed from last season in a tin under the roof, so I do not need to buy anything. Beans fix their own food from the air, so I do not put fertilizer on them—besides, one bag would be too much for this tiny field, and I do not have the strength to carry manure so far anymore. My grandchildren help me with the hoe for planting and weeding, but I do not pay anyone because we have no spare cash for that.
